The [[Mandalorian]] [[foundling]] and [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] was instructed by a mentor<ref name="Chapter 14" /> sometime before the former's [[death]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> A portion of the mentor's name was recorded within the [[chain code]] of Jango's [[Cloning|clone]] son, [[Boba Fett|Boba]], in which it was written in the [[Mando'a]] [[Mandalorian (writing system)|script]]. The name was partially spelled as "'''Jaste'''."<ref name="Chapter 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChainCode-TMCh14.png|thumb|right|200px|The mentor's name was encoded within Boba Fett's chain code.]]
The mentor was mentioned on a hologram in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> The character's name was partially obscured within the episode, which made it difficult to determine the individual's full name.<ref name="Chapter 14" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] mentor was [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] [[Jaster Mereel]], who first appeared in flashbacks in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 1|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 1]], written by [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]], penciled by [[Ramón F. Bachs]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="JFOS1">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 1|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 1]]</ref> in [[2002]].<ref name="JF Date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20020401.html|text=Jango Covers & Late Summer Comics}}</ref>
